appearance_facts.fact: A single teal line with black circular markers descends from the upper-left (2005) to the lower-right (2014), with each point labeled by its value.
Leftmost point, labeled 23.9°C, positioned near the top of the y-axis scale.
Rightmost point, labeled 10.1°C, positioned near the bottom of the visible data range, well below the 2005 point.
Values step down across 2006–2013, with a small plateau between 2010 (15.5°C) and 2011 (15.3°C).
Y-axis is vertical (0 at bottom to ~23 at top); x-axis runs left-to-right 2005→2014.

printed_facts.fact: Review scope: River Temperature change, 2005-2014; Routing criterion: Whether the full-period river temperature change requires substantial-change follow-up

public_definitions: Determine whether the full-period (2005→2014) river temperature change requires substantial-change follow-up or remains routine monitoring.
Option A: Route to substantial-change follow-up.
Option B: Keep on routine monitoring for ordinary variation.
Option C: Route to archive and background filing.
uncertain: No numeric threshold defining 'substantial' vs 'ordinary' change is printed on the dashboard or form; the decision relies on interpreting the magnitude of the 23.9°C→10.1°C drop.
No policy table or legend clarifies routing rules beyond the stated criterion.
